name: gputw
description: Official GPUtw skill and MCP server — deploy and manage GPU instances on gputw.ai, move models into /vault, and debug the API, in natural language.

api_key.title: GPUtw API key
api_key.description: A scoped key from the GPUtw dashboard → API Keys (starts with gputw_live_). Stored in secure storage, never written to plain config. Use the narrowest preset that fits: readonly to look, deploy to launch, operator to stop/restart, Upload token for CI uploads.

allow_exec.title: Allow running commands inside instances
allow_exec.description: Exposes exec-in-instance, which runs commands as root inside your container and needs a key with the instances:exec scope (only the `full` preset grants it). Every call is written to your account audit trail. Leave off unless you need it.
